Metadata.titleDefault: Maison Aurèle — Fine Jewellery, Montréal & Paris
Metadata.description: Contemporary fine jewellery made in our Old Montréal atelier. Stones traced from mine to setting, certified recycled gold. Private salon in Paris, by appointment.

Footer.intro: Contemporary fine jewellery, drawn and made by hand in our Old Montréal atelier since 2011.
Footer.montrealHours: Tuesday to Saturday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.
Footer.commitments: Certified recycled gold · Stones traced from mine to setting

Home.heroLede: Since 2011, our Old Montréal atelier has shaped pieces that hold the light — and give it back at the slightest gesture.
Home.manifestoTitle: A stone has no brilliance of its own.
Home.manifesto1: It receives the light, bends it, breaks it apart, then returns it transformed. Our entire craft lives in that instant.
Home.manifesto2: Every piece is drawn around that gesture: the angle of a prong, the height of a setting, the weight of a band. Nothing is ornamental; everything serves the light.
Home.manifesto3: Our stones are traced from mine to setting, and our gold is recycled and certified. Beauty whose origins are known is worn more lightly.
Home.collectionsTitle: Three ways of holding the light.
Home.appointmentText: In Montréal, in Paris or from afar, an hour that is entirely yours: to try on, to understand a stone, to imagine a commission. Never any obligation.
Home.tiltPrompt: Tilt to play with the light
Home.heroAlt: Aube Première ring in white gold: a 1.02-carat diamond on six fine prongs, turning slowly in the light.

Ecrin.metaTitle: The Écrin — the pieces you set aside
Ecrin.metaDescription: The Maison Aurèle pieces you have set aside, to return to or share discreetly.
Ecrin.title: Your pieces, set aside.
Ecrin.lede: Keep the pieces that hold your attention here. They stay on this device, with no account, and can be shared with a simple link.
Ecrin.emptyHint: On each piece, “Keep in my Écrin” sets it aside so you can return to it at leisure.
Ecrin.shareText: A link is all it takes: for someone looking for an idea, or for yourself, for later. Nothing is stored on our side.
Ecrin.hidePricesHint: To suggest without numbers: prices will not appear on the shared page.
Ecrin.privacy: The link only contains the chosen pieces, never your name.
Ecrin.sharedTitle: A few pieces, chosen with care.
